title: The Last Rivergate
author: Mara Lockridge
blurb: Petra Underhill, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the dry season ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
